messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High kv_arena_fragmentation_rate detected on prod-eu-gpu-pool — 23 hosts over threshold (0.82). Error spike: cudaMalloc failures + increased tail latency. Pager: @jessica (oncall)
pagerduty-bot: Paging jessica (oncall) — urgency: high — incident created: INC-2026-3382
jessica (oncall): on it, joining now. Any customer reports yet?
maria (sre): seeing burst of 5xx and elevated p95 token latency for text.generate in eu-west. Errors look like `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` and some `Allocator::fragmentation` logs.
omar (eng-runtime): logs from a few hosts:```[2026-03-15 02:14:03] ERROR kv_arena.cc:237 arena_alloc() failed: cannot find contiguous slab, total_free=2.1GB, largest_free=64MB
[2026-03-15 02:14:03] ERROR cuda_driver.cc:412 cudaMalloc 134217728 failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15 02:14:04] WARN batcher.cc:480 continuous_batch_size=2048, inflight_tokens spiking
```
jessica (oncall): ok fragmentation + large continuous batches. Hypothesis: continuous batching bump + allocator fragmentation causing cudaMalloc churn and OOMs. Is this new rollout?
dmitri (eng-ml): we rolled quantized 8bit model variant to eu region last night with a config that increased default continuous_batch_size to 2048 for throughput. Could be correlated.
omar (eng-runtime): confirmed — canary release `q8-v2` rolled at 23:00 UTC. Traffic split 15% -> now serving ~40% on several nodes due to routing ripple.
jessica (oncall): immediate mitigation: throttle continuous_batch_size and cap per-worker inflight tokens, and enable arena eager-compaction flag. Can someone push ephemeral config? I can do a rolling restart after patch.
maria (sre): I'll craft a cluster-level hotfix. Plan: set `CONT_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=512` and `ARENA_COMPACT_THRESHOLD=0.6` on prod-eu-gpu-pool, apply to 5 hosts canary, observe 10m, then roll.
product-ops: heads-up — we may see increased latency briefly; prepping comms.
omar (eng-runtime): patch manifest snippet:```- name: inference-runtime
  env:
    - name: CONT_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS
      value: "512"
    - name: ARENA_COMPACT_THRESHOLD
      value: "0.6"
```
omar (eng-runtime): applying to hosts: eu-gpu-12 -> eu-gpu-16 (canary). kubectl set env on daemonset, then restart pods gracefully. Doing now.
jessica (oncall): executing canary restart on eu-gpu-12..16. Will watch memory and error metrics.
(5m later)
maria (sre): canary looks promising: fragmentation_rate down from 0.82 -> 0.28 on those hosts, cudaMalloc errors dropped to 0. Error rate for canary pod routes went from 6.8% -> 0.4%.
dmitri (eng-ml): interesting — the smaller continuous batches dramatically reduced KV growth; expected since per-request KV footprints were often padded by long sequences.
omar (eng-runtime): rolling to remainder of pool in 3 waves with 10 hosts each, using drain/evict then restart to avoid customer-influenced hot paths. Starting wave 1.
customer-support: receiving a couple of angry tickets about timeouts for document-summarize in EU. Are we seeing request failures?
jessica (oncall): yes some 502s/timeouts during the initial surge. Need to quantify customer impact: Maria, can you run a quick query on affected customers and percent of failed requests?
maria (sre): running query now. SQL:```SELECT customer_id, count(*) as total, sum(case when status >= 500 then 1 else 0 end) as errors
FROM requests
WHERE region='eu-west' AND model LIKE 'q8-v2%' AND ts >= '2026-03-15T01:30:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY errors DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
maria (sre): preliminary: top impacted customer (cust_478) had 18% 5xx rate for that period; overall eu-west error rate peaked at 4.6% above baseline. No PII exposed.
product-ops: preparing customer advisory for cust_478 and customers over 5% errors. Draft floor: brief incident statement + mitigation and ETA for postmortem.
jessica (oncall): continue roll. Wave 2 complete. Observed small blip in latency during each pod restart but no new OOMs.
omar (eng-runtime): after full roll, fragmentation_rate cluster-wide down to 0.22, overall p95 tokens back to normal. cudaMalloc errors nearly zero.
dmitri (eng-ml): follow-up: we should revert the continuous batching default for q8-v2 to a safer value in config repo and require explicit perf tests before rollouts.
maria (sre): immediate post-incident actions: 1) revert q8-v2 default continuous_batch_size change, 2) add allocator compaction metrics to the SLO dashboard, 3) create a canary gate to limit traffic ripple to 10%. Adding to runbook.
jessica (oncall): status: mitigated -> not actively paging. Creating oncall handoff note for next shift. Will keep incident channel open for 30m for observation.
(10m later)
maria (sre): watching for regressions; nothing new. Customer impact notification queued.
product-ops: sent triage email to cust_478 and 3 other affected customers with apology + immediate mitigations + offer for credits.
customer-support: closing 2 tickets after customers acknowledged they've retried and are OK.
jessica (oncall): final notes: Root cause: allocator fragmentation amplified by increased continuous batch sizes from a model rollout combined with routing ripple that concentrated q8-v2 on subset of nodes. Fix: emergency cap + arena compaction flag + coordinated rolling restart. Long-term: better canary gating, pre-rollout perf tests simulating KV growth, and allocator tuning (arena reslice heuristics).
omar (eng-runtime): created PR to change default continuous_batch_size back and add automated perf test: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4821
dmitri (eng-ml): will add KV-heavy synthetic workload to model onboarding tests.
maria (sre): follow-up doc: assign postmortem owner (jessica), timeline draft, and action owners. I'll attach metrics and logs.
jessica (oncall): assigning postmortem owner to me. I'll kick off template and invite eng-runtime + eng-ml. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3382 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Follow-up: postmortem requested.
(END THREAD)
